name: Ocean Overhaul
description: Adds 41 ocean-themed blocks (decorative: Abyssal Coral Block, Sea Glass, Polished Prismarine Bricks, Pearl Block, Kelp Brick, Chiseled Prismarine Tiles, Cracked Kelp Bricks — most with stairs/slab/wall; driftwood functional set: Driftwood Plank + stairs/slab/wall, Fence, Fence Gate, Trapdoor, Door, Button, Pressure Plate; plus Pearl Lantern, Salt Block, Barnacle Block, Nautilus Shell Block, Abyssal Pearl Block, Crushed Coral Block, Prismarine Crystal Block), 8 items (Tide Pearl, Coral Shard, Sea Salt, Kelp Fiber, Abyssal Pearl, Crushed Coral, Sea Urchin, Salted Cod), and a dedicated Ocean Overhaul creative tab.
